query.description: YMS 반영용 E-Test 파일 1건 + 반영 상태 + Map Wafer 크기(µm). 없으면 0행
query.commandtext: SELECT F.SRC_FILE_SEQ, F.FACTORY, F.DEVICE_ID, F.TEST_PROGRAM, F.MAP_ID, F.LOT_ID, F.WAFER_ID, F.LOT_WAFER_NO, F.FILE_NAME, F.TEST_TIME, F.LOAD_STATUS, F.YMS_STATUS, F.YMS_PROGRAM, F.YMS_LOT_SEQ, F.YMS_WAFER_SEQ, F.YMS_TIME, F.YMS_MESSAGE, (SELECT MAX(M.WAFER_SIZE) FROM TQP_MAPDEF M WHERE M.FACTORY = F.FACTORY AND M.MAPID = F.MAP_ID) AS WAFER_SIZE FROM TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE F WHERE F.SRC_FILE_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(:f_seq)

query.description: 파일에 값이 저장된 등록 Parameter + YMS 컬럼 이름(YMS_PARAM_NAME, 30자, 2026-10-21) + 헤더 원문 / 단위 + Spec(사용 Y 인 것만)
query.commandtext: SELECT I.ET_ITEM_SEQ, I.ITEM_NAME, I.YMS_PARAM_NAME, I.HEADER_TEXT, NVL(I.UNIT, L.UNIT) AS UNIT, CASE WHEN L.ENABLE_FLAG = 'Y' THEN L.LOWER_LIMIT END AS LOWER_LIMIT, CASE WHEN L.ENABLE_FLAG = 'Y' THEN L.UPPER_LIMIT END AS UPPER_LIMIT FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM I JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT V.ET_ITEM_SEQ FROM TQP_GDS_ET_VALUE V WHERE V.SRC_FILE_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(:p_seq)) S ON S.ET_ITEM_SEQ = I.ET_ITEM_SEQ LEFT JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT L ON L.FACTORY = I.FACTORY AND L.DEVICE_ID = I.DEVICE_ID AND L.TEST_PROGRAM = I.TEST_PROGRAM AND L.ITEM_NAME = I.ITEM_NAME ORDER BY I.DISPLAY_ORDER, I.ITEM_NAME

query.description: 파일 Die: 시스템 Map 좌표 / 파일 Hardware · Software Bin / 파일 DUT 결과 (YMS BIN = Hardware Bin, 2026-10-14)
query.commandtext: SELECT D.DUT_NO, D.MAP_X, D.MAP_Y, D.HW_BIN, D.SW_BIN, D.PASS_FLAG FROM TQP_GDS_ET_DIE D WHERE D.SRC_FILE_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(:d_seq) ORDER BY D.DUT_NO
SELECT V.DUT_NO, V.ET_ITEM_SEQ, V.MEAS_VALUE, V.VALUE_STATUS FROM TQP_GDS_ET_VALUE V WHERE V.SRC_FILE_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(:v_seq)

query.description: YMS 반영 키 기록 (Lot / Wafer 를 만든 직후, 또는 빈 값으로 지움)
query.commandtext: UPDATE TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE SET YMS_PROGRAM = :k_program, YMS_LOT_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(:k_lot), YMS_WAFER_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(:k_wafer) WHERE SRC_FILE_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(:k_seq)

query.description: YMS 반영 결과 기록 (상태 / 시각 / 메시지). 키는 새 값이 있을 때만 바꾼다
query.commandtext: UPDATE TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE SET YMS_STATUS = :s_status, YMS_PROGRAM = NVL(:s_program, YMS_PROGRAM), YMS_LOT_SEQ = NVL(TO_NUMBER(:s_lot), YMS_LOT_SEQ), YMS_WAFER_SEQ = NVL(TO_NUMBER(:s_wafer), YMS_WAFER_SEQ), YMS_TIME = SYSDATE, YMS_MESSAGE = :s_message WHERE SRC_FILE_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(:s_seq)

query.description: YMS Parameter 정의 보정: 설명(헤더 원문) / 단위 / LSL / USL / 형식 (ExecuteMultiple)
query.commandtext: UPDATE TQP_PARASPEC SET PARAM_DESC = :param_desc, UOM = :uom, LSL = CAST(TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:lsl) AS NUMBER), USL = CAST(TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:usl) AS NUMBER), PARAM_TYPE = :param_type, UPDATE_USER = :update_user, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND PROGRAM = :program AND PROGRAM_REV = TO_NUMBER(:program_rev) AND PARAM_NAME = :param_name

query.description: Bin 설정: READY 파일이 있는 Device + 공정, 파일 수 / YMS 반영(DONE) 파일 수 (2026-10-22)
query.commandtext: SELECT F.DEVICE_ID, F.TEST_PROGRAM, COUNT(*) AS FILE_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN F.YMS_STATUS = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS YMS_FILE_COUNT FROM TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE F WHERE F.FACTORY = :factory AND F.LOAD_STATUS = 'READY' GROUP BY F.DEVICE_ID, F.TEST_PROGRAM ORDER BY F.DEVICE_ID, F.TEST_PROGRAM

query.description: Bin 설정: Device + 공정 READY 파일 Die 를 Hardware Bin / Software Bin / 파일로 묶은 수. 합치기는 BSL (LISTAGG DISTINCT 는 19c 부터라 쓰지 않음, 2026-10-22)
query.commandtext: SELECT D.HW_BIN, D.SW_BIN, D.SRC_FILE_SEQ, COUNT(*) AS DIE_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN D.PASS_FLAG = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PASS_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN D.PASS_FLAG = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FAIL_COUNT FROM TQP_GDS_ET_DIE D JOIN TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE F ON F.SRC_FILE_SEQ = D.SRC_FILE_SEQ WHERE F.FACTORY = :factory AND F.DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND F.TEST_PROGRAM = :test_program AND F.LOAD_STATUS = 'READY' GROUP BY D.HW_BIN, D.SW_BIN, D.SRC_FILE_SEQ

query.description: Bin 설정: YMS Program 의 Bin 정의 (TQP_BINDESC, 2026-10-22)
query.commandtext: SELECT B.BIN, B.BIN_NAME, B.HIGH_GEC, B.COLOR, B.DESCRIPTION FROM TQP_BINDESC B WHERE B.PROGRAM = :program ORDER BY B.BIN

query.description: Bin 설정 저장 (ExecuteMultiple): 있으면 이름 / 양품 / 색 / 설명만, 없으면 새 정의(표시 Y, Map 기호 / Limit 없음 = 업로드 자동 등록과 같음, 2026-10-22)
query.commandtext: MERGE INTO TQP_BINDESC T USING (SELECT :program AS PROGRAM, TO_NUMBER(:bin) AS BIN, :bin_name AS BIN_NAME, :high_gec AS HIGH_GEC, :color AS COLOR, :description AS DESCRIPTION FROM DUAL) S ON (T.PROGRAM = S.PROGRAM AND T.BIN = S.BIN) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.BIN_NAME = S.BIN_NAME, T.HIGH_GEC = S.HIGH_GEC, T.COLOR = S.COLOR, T.DESCRIPTION = S.DESCRIPTION WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PROGRAM, BIN, BIN_NAME, HIGH_GEC, DISPLAY, COLOR, DESCRIPTION) VALUES (S.PROGRAM, S.BIN, S.BIN_NAME, S.HIGH_GEC, 'Y', S.COLOR, S.DESCRIPTION)
DELETE FROM TQP_BINDESC WHERE PROGRAM = :program AND BIN = TO_NUMBER(:bin)
